title: Intercepting routes is broken with Catch-all Segments

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Linking and Navigating
labels.description: Related to Next.js linking (e.g., <Link>) and navigation.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body: ### Link to the code that reproduces this issue https://github.com/padupuy/nextgram ### To Reproduce I try to implement intercepting routes with catch-all segments. I fork the [nextgram repo](https://github.com/padupuy/nextgram) and i replace the hardcoded photos folder with a dynamic route [...slug] to catch the route photos/[id] to mimic a CMS behviour 1. The result is buggy : behind the photo modal we can see the photo page instead of the grid feed. 2. When the modal is open : the params.slug is equal to [ 'photos2' ] instead of ['photos', 2] Check the live example here : https://nextgram-three.vercel.app/ ### Current vs. Expected behavior The intercepting routes with catch-all segments must work as the "standard" intercepting route , see this example https://nextgram.vercel.app/. When the user click on a picture, a modal is open. The grid feed behind should be still displayed. ### Verify canary release - [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release ### Provide environment information ```bash Operating System: Platform: darwin Arch: x64 Version: Darwin Kernel Version 22.6.0: Wed Oct 4 21:25:26 PDT 2023; root:xnu-8796.141.3.701.17~4/RELEASE_X86_64 Binaries: Node: 20.9.0 npm: 10.1.0 Yarn: 1.22.19 pnpm: N/A Relevant Packages: next: 14.0.5-canary.18 eslint-config-next: N/A react: 18.2.0 react-dom: 18.2.0 typescript: 5.1.3 Next.js Config: output: N/A ``` ### Which area(s) are affected? (Select all that apply) App Router, Routing (next/router, next/navigation, next/link) ### Additional context _No response_ [NEXT-1906](https://linear.app/vercel/issue/NEXT-1906/intercepting-routes-is-broken-with-catch-all-segments)
